scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for all stated parameters; finite verification is supplementary, and originality is limited to the exact combined path-specific affine census and 2-adic forcing obstruction. Classical type-A Coxeter structure and general affine-map methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed permutation sweeps of self-inclusive neighbor parity with constant affine offsets on finite paths; finite characteristic-two fields only. Not asserted for cycles, general graphs, changing update orders, or nonlinear rules. Full historical equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: An alternating forcing dichotomy for affine parity sweeps on paths
